investigation_notes: Network security investigation of a monitored LAN. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over Zeek and Suricata logs (IDS alerts, Kerberos, HTTP downloads, TLS certificates, domains and external-destination activity). No root cause, impact or C2 attribution is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Network context: LAN segment range: 172.17.0.0/24 (172.17.0.0 through 172.17.0.255); Domain: bepositive.com; Active Directory (AD) domain controller: 172.17.0.17 - WIN-CTL9XBQ9Y19; AD environment name: BEPOSITIVE; LAN segment gateway: 172.17.0.1; LAN segment broadcast address: 172.17.0.255.
